description: This file defines the class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelEditRoleButton', which is a widget for rendering an edit role button in a subpanel within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It contains methods to display header cells and list items for this widget, primarily generating HTML links to edit roles within the CRM interface.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelEditRoleButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering an 'edit role' button in subpanels within the CRM, extending 'SugarWidgetField' and providing methods to display header cells and list entries.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space as a placeholder for the header cell in the subpanel grid.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML link to edit the role associated with a subpanel item, based on the layout definition and global variables.
